Rift, a fast file manager for Windows with tabs and side-by-side panes. This release is about finding out
when something goes wrong.

## Download

- **`Rift-win-Setup.exe`**: installs Rift for your user (no admin rights, no .NET needed). Already have 0.9? It updates itself.
- **`Rift-win-Portable.zip`**: runs from any folder, no install, and updates itself too.

The exe isn't signed yet, so SmartScreen may warn on the first start: "More info" → "Run anyway".

## New in 0.10

- Logs: what goes wrong is written to `%AppData%\Rift\logs`, a file a day, kept for a week. Settings → "Open logs"
- Crash reports: if Rift crashes, a report is saved next to the logs, and the next start offers to report it on GitHub.
  The issue is filled in with the version and the stack trace; exception messages and log lines, which can name
  your files, are left out, and you see everything before sending
- PageUp and PageDown move a screenful in the tiles and thumbnail views

See [ROADMAP.md](https://github.com/keyldev/rift/blob/main/ROADMAP.md) for what's next.
